evidence_items.explanation: The developers describe compressing the full 671-billion-parameter R1 to 131GB and running it with limited RAM. This supports technical local feasibility, while explicitly qualifying speed and leaving broad benchmark parity unestablished.
The original V3 release uses a model license with use restrictions. Its licensing cannot simply be equated with R1's MIT terms; this is background from before the target period.

unresolved_gaps: No matched inference-cost or computational-efficiency measurement establishes a general thirtyfold advantage.
The sentence supplies no model-wide price comparison or workload.
The local demonstration does not establish ordinary interactive speed or unchanged benchmark quality on modest hardware.
